name: delegate-watch
description: Live pane that watches agy, Claude Code, cursor-agent and opencode delegate runs while they work

watchPaths.title: Folders to watch
watchPaths.description: Where delegate run folders live. Each is absolute, or relative to the folder Claude Code was started in. $TMPDIR and ~ are expanded. Searched recursively.

searchDepth.title: Search depth
searchDepth.description: How many folder levels below each watched folder to search for run logs.

maxAgeHours.title: Run age limit (hours)
maxAgeHours.description: Only runs whose log changed within this many hours are shown.

maxSessions.title: Session chips
maxSessions.description: How many of the most recent runs get a chip at the top of the pane (1 to 12).

timelineRows.title: Timeline rows
timelineRows.description: How many events the timeline shows at once (also adjustable with the − / + buttons in the pane, which remember your choice). 0 sizes it to the pane height. Higher values draw more rows each refresh.
